name_reason: Fully compliant fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>. 'spell_handler' = dispatch-table handler; 'id_0' is a real spell domain ID (spell 0x00 = 火炎術, an offensive attack spell), not address residue -- confirmed by the function-pointer table @ 0x51D01 whose slot 0 holds 0x00021206 and by the hardcoded spell_id=0 passed to the worker. 'via_targeted_blink' accurately names the worker variant fd2_execute_offensive_targeted_spell, which uses the BLINK-OVERLAY animation (fd2_animate_spell_overlay_blink), distinguishing this family from the full_screen_flash family. No address-residue suffix (fn is @ 0x21206; name has no _206/_1206).
purpose: Spell dispatch handler for spell id 0 (火炎術 / Fireball): thin wrapper that delegates to the offensive targeted-spell worker with spell_id hardcoded to 0.
logic_summary: Calls fd2_execute_offensive_targeted_spell(caster, 0, n_targets, target_id_array). spell_id literal = 0. In the binary this entry also serves as the shared-tail for sibling thunks (id 1/2/3/8) that JMP into its body at 0x2121A to reuse the PUSH-caster + CALL-worker + cleanup + RET tail; in src each handler is emitted as its own one-line wrapper (functionally equivalent). Entry is reached via the spell function-pointer table @ 0x51D01 (slot 0).

params.name: caster_unit_id
params.semantics: Battle unit id of the casting unit; forwarded as arg1 to the worker.
params.reason: Accurately names the casting unit id; no address residue. (src spells it 'caster' -- same meaning.)

params.name: num_targets
params.semantics: Number of target ids in target_id_array; forwarded as arg3 to the worker (drives the per-target damage loop).
params.reason: Accurate count semantics; no address residue. (src spells it 'n_tgt'.)

params.name: target_id_array
params.semantics: Pointer to a byte array of target unit ids; forwarded (as int) as arg4 to the worker and indexed per target.
params.reason: Accurately names the target-id byte array pointer; no address residue. (src spells it 'tgt_arr'.)

returns.semantics: No return value; effect is the delegated spell execution (animation, MP deduction, per-target damage).

notes: Thin one-line wrapper; src comment coverage is the file header (pattern families + dispatch table @ 0x51D01) plus the section marker '=== Targeted blink family (id 0-3, 8) ===', which correctly documents this handler. No per-function comment needed; comment kept. Ghidra plate is far more detailed (multi-entry shared-tail structure, body instructions) and is consistent with the src conclusion -> plate left unchanged. The decompile's __CHK(0x14,...) + in_stack_00000000 are the Watcom stack-probe thunk artifacts (auto re-emitted by the compiler), not logic to port -- no issue. Arg order verified against worker signature fd2_execute_offensive_targeted_spell(caster, spell_id, n_targets, p_targets).
